definitions.explanation: Expresses the speaker's intention or plan to do something.
Indicates what the speaker believes or assumes to be the case (sometimes contrary to reality).

examples.japanese: ⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧つもり⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I plan to go to Japan next year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手伝|てつだ}う→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧つもり⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧んです⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧...
⟦ちゃんと→ちゃんと：02359_chanto⟧⟦やった→やる：02980_yaru⟧つもり⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I believe I did it properly.
examples.notes: Expressing belief about one's own action

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧つもり⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: I was planning to move next month, but my plans changed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧つもり⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧、⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{正直|しょうじき}→正直：01562_shoujiki⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Even if you think you're young, your body is honest.
examples.notes: Xのつもり = believing oneself to be X

examples.japanese: ⟦{説明|せつめい}した→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧つもりだった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{全然|ぜんぜん}→全然：00598_zenzen⟧⟦{伝|つた}わっていなかった→伝わる：01961_tsutawaru⟧。
examples.english: I thought I had explained it, but it didn't get through at all.

notes:
つもり expresses the speaker's intention or belief. It follows the plain form of verbs or adjectives.

INTENTION (Sense 1):
- Verb (plain) + つもり: ⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧つもり (intend to go)
- Verb (negative) + つもり: ⟦{行|い}かない→行く：00119_iku⟧つもり (intend not to go)
- Past intention: つもり⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧ (⟦{手伝|てつだ}う→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧つもり⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧ — I had intended to help)

BELIEF/ASSUMPTION (Sense 2):
- Past verb + つもり: ⟦やった→やる：02980_yaru⟧つもり (I believe I did it)
- Adjective + つもり: ⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧つもり (thinking oneself young)
- This usage often implies the reality may differ from the belief.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧: scheduled plan (more concrete, often external)
- つもり: personal intention (internal, may not be fixed)

WRITING:
The kanji {積|つ}もり exists but hiragana is standard.
